families.name: EXTREME_CROSS_SECTIONAL_DISLOCATION_REVERSAL
families.mechanism: At a LATE decision time (14:00 ET, deliberately later than F6's opening-range fade and Task71's 11:00 residual-momentum decision), rank each universe symbol's open(09:30)->decision(14:00) return against the OTHER 34 symbols' same-day same-window returns (cross-sectional percentile rank, causal -- uses only same-day public price data already available to every market participant by 14:00, not future information). An EXTREME dislocation (top or bottom percentile) that has already begun to STALL (exhaustion confirmation: the last 30 minutes' return is smaller in magnitude, or opposite in sign, than the return accumulated before that) is hypothesized to partially mean-revert into the close. Differs materially from Task71 Family C (single-stock market-beta residual, 11:00 decision, no cross-sectional ranking, no exhaustion confirmation) and from F6 (opening-range fade, not a late-day cross-sectional-extremity reversal).

families.name: VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION
families.mechanism: At a MID-MORNING decision time (11:30 ET, deliberately avoiding the crowded open and distinct from Task71's 11:00 residual-momentum decision), compute today's partial-session (09:30->11:30) high-low range relative to a CAUSAL trailing 10-trading-day average FULL-day range (prior days only, current day excluded). A sufficiently large range_expansion_ratio COMBINED WITH a genuine break of the causal trailing 10-day high (for LONG) or low (for SHORT) is hypothesized to continue (not fade/revert) through the rest of the session, since volatility expansion + structural break together indicate a real supply/demand shift, not mere noise. Differs materially from Task71 Family A (AVWAP-distance flow-state, no volatility-expansion or trailing-high/low structural confirmation, 30-120m horizons from an 11:00 decision) and from Task71 Family D (looks for FAILED breaks/reclaims, the opposite mechanism -- this family requires the break to hold, not fail).

search_budget.note: 24 <= 36; deliberately fewer than the cap, per the task's own preference for a smaller search than Task71's 72-cell grid.

promotion_rule_economic_edge_first.explicit_prohibition: Do not lower this bar after seeing results. Statistical significance (CI excludes zero) or PF>1 alone is NOT sufficient for promotion.

robustness_requirements_for_nomination: 3. at least 3 adjacent/related parameter cells share the same sign
4. no isolated winner surrounded by negative neighbors
5. positive in at least 3 of the 4 distinct development regime slices
6. no single symbol >30% of positive economics
7. no single day >30% of positive economics
8. top-3-winner removal remains >=0 or only mildly negative
16. no heavy reliance on volume unless explicitly classified PROVIDER_SENSITIVE
18. no long/short pooling to hide one failing side -- every cell reported by direction separately

candidate_cap.research_lead_requires: meaningfully close to the promotion bar, not merely 'interesting'
